tree = py_trees.composites.Parallel(
    name="HomeAutomationTasks",
    policy=py_trees.common.ParallelPolicy.SuccessOnAll(),
    children=[
        py_trees.composites.Sequence(
            name="GuestBedroomDehumidifier",
            memory=True,
            children=[
                py_trees.composites.Selector(
                    name="EnsureDehumidifierOn",
                    memory=False,
                    children=[
                        PropertyConditionNode(
                            name="IsDehumidifierOn",
                            property_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home86/guest_bedroom/artifacts/guestBedroomDehumidifiers/properties/state",
                            expected_value="on"
                        ),
                        ActionAffordanceNode(
                            name="TurnOnDehumidifier",
                            action_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home86/guest_bedroom/artifacts/guestBedroomDehumidifiers/turn_on"
                        )
                    ]
                ),
                ActionAffordanceNode(
                    name="SetDehumidifierIntensity",
                    action_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home86/guest_bedroom/artifacts/guestBedroomDehumidifiers/set_intensity",
                    parameters={"intensity": 90}
                )
            ]
        ),
        py_trees.composites.Sequence(
            name="BalconyLight",
            memory=True,
            children=[
                py_trees.composites.Selector(
                    name="EnsureLightOn",
                    memory=False,
                    children=[
                        PropertyConditionNode(
                            name="IsLightOn",
                            property_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home86/balcony/artifacts/balconyLight/properties/state",

                        ActionAffordanceNode(
                            name="TurnOnLight",

                        )
                    ]
                ),
                ActionAffordanceNode(
                    name="SetLightBrightness",
                    action_url="http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home86/balcony/artifacts/balconyLight/set_brightness",
                    parameters={"brightness": 40}

            ]
        ),
        py_trees.composites.Sequence(
            name="LivingRoomCurtain",
            memory=True,
            children=[
                py_trees.composites.Selector(
                    name="EnsureCurtainOpen",

plan.explanation:
The behavior tree is designed to perform the achievable tasks in parallel, ensuring that each device is in the correct state before performing the desired action. 

1. **Guest Bedroom Dehumidifier**: 
   - A sequence is used to first ensure the dehumidifier is turned on. If it is not on, it will be turned on. Then, the intensity is set to 90.

2. **Balcony Light**: 
   - A sequence is used to ensure the light is turned on. If it is not on, it will be turned on. Then, the brightness is set to 40 (83 - 43).

3. **Living Room Curtain**: 
   - A sequence is used to ensure the curtain is open. If it is not open, it will be opened. Then, the degree is set to 20 (0 + 20).

The tasks that cannot be performed due to unavailable devices or actions are listed as impossible at the top of the code.
